shortDescription: Venezuela expects almost $76 billion of investment in its oil and gas sector over the next five years, Acting President Delcy Rodríguez said Saturday, according to Bloomberg. The country is seeking to attract private capital to boost energy production.

title: Venezuela Expects Almost $76 Billion in Oil and Gas Investment Over Five Years
